book.title: MATYU Kamambuno wakai Matyu muno boglkwa

content: Yesus auro ipi Pailat moglmara eingwa
Tangina kinde kana pris kande wagle prapra ya te yomba mina mogl okuna endingwa Yesus sigoraglkwa pre ana ka digi dingwa.
Ye baklain indre Yesus kanesi auro yendpi ana Rom gavman kande mogl gumamugl endungwa, Pailat ye ongo mina yeingwa.
Judas yene kansi goglkwa

Judas eremogl Yesus i-pene ende kunda ikine onguno mina yongwa yaglmo, ye kango Yesus ka-tange tendre yumbun teingo, ye erekinde orkwa i pirtre nomane yake tendre ana moni mongo 30 silva ikra yend ikine wu pris kande wagle ya te ende okuna eingwa yomba tongwa.
Judas dungwa, “Na tandaglme ere, yagl du-wakai aglau ta erekrukwa ene onguno mina yeingwa.” Ana ye di ikine endingwa, “I no sragl eramun? I enene mina pangwa.”
Judas ye moni silva mongo i piyasi God holi yungumo kande yungugl ende ana ende menda pi yene kansi goglkwa.
Pris kande wagle ye moni silva ikra gande indre ana dingwa, “Moni i topo tendre yomba sigeglkwa. Ana God holi yungumo moni yongwa i bogl i-suwara endekramga. Nono lono mane dungwa.”
Okuwo ye ka i digidi pandigl ana ye moni ikra indre makan gala bekingwa yomba ye makano topo erimbi ana yomba yongugl gitno pene yenambuka.
Yeglpre makanmo i kangiye yegl yeingwa, ‘Bormai Makan’ erme ama kangiye yegl dagl meglkwa.
Ana propet Jeremaia okuna ka ta dungwa kamo i paiyungwa, “Israel yomba okuna ye pre topomo dipandiglmara, ye moni 30 silva ingwa.
Ana ye moni ikra makan gala beke beke orkwa yomba ye makanmo topo ere ingwa, i Yaglkande yegl ero dinarmere.”
Pailat krapogl Yesus tongwa
Yesus eremogl Rom gavman kande Pailat moglmara guma mina andigl moglko ana gavman krapogl tongwa, “Ene Juda yomba ye kingno motno?” Ana Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Owo, i enene yegl dinga.”
Ana pris kande wagle ya te ende okuna eingwa yomba ye kakimbi di nangiye dangingwa. Ba ye ka ta dikor erekrukwa.
Ana Pailat ditongwa, “Ene taragl yegl etne di ana di nangin dangingwa i ene prapra ta pirkitno?”
Ba Yesus ka dingwa i suwara kaima ta di ikine endekrukwa, ipre gavana ye kundugl pond kaima goglkwa.
Pailat eremogl Yesus endi-prak mina sigolo dungwa

Pasova kaiya mokna neingwa engemo yongo Rom gavman ye mambunono ta pangwa i kane paingwa yomba suwarandi poko ende-ende erikwa. I yomba merkinde krapogl yomba ta kangiye daglkwa yombamo i keunde kane poko ende-ende erikwa.
Enge igle yagl ta kane pai moglkwa ana yomba prapra pirkondingwa i kangiye, Yesus Barabas.
Yeglpre yomba merkinde umakaisi meglko Pailat krapogl yomba tongwa, “Na yagl ira kane poko endimbo ende ene meglmara unambedi pirme? Yesus Barabas mo, Yesus ye Krais we dingwa ikra?”
Ye pirkan ere kondingwa. Pris kande wagle mirmogl tendre Yesus kanesi ye teingwa.

Ana Pailat kot pirkwa yungu yungugl kra bogl mina amedi moglko, embiye ka yegl di ye mina endungwa, “Ene yomba du-yene i taragl kanekane ta ere tenatnga paikrukwa. Sraglpre, na erme enduwer kumbumo ta kaninga pre kundugl pond goglka.”
Ba pris kande wagle ya te ende okuna eingwa yomba ye yomba merkinde di nusindre Pailat ditembi kade ye Barabas kane yoko poko endinan ana Yesus ipi sigoraglkwa pre dingwa.
Ana Pailat yomba merkinde meglmara krapogl tongwa, “Ene pirmbi na yomba suwo i ira kane yoko poko endimbo ende ene meglmara unambe?” Ye di ikine endingwa, “Barabas.”
Pailat ye krapogl tongwa, “Yesus ye Krais we dingwa, i na sragl ere tenagle?” Yomba prapra di ikine endingwa, “Ye endi-prak mina siyo.”
Ba Pailat krapoglkwa, “Ye sragl taragl ere aglau orme?” Ana ye mambuno bogl mangre kaglka digo, nunguno embriye ende mitna imbo kaima ongwa, “Ye endi-prak mina siyo!”

Ana Pailat i kangwa yomba ye yene oglagldi kunda gua beglmbi, ye di akedu endinambuka mere mango ana ye nigl tau indre yomba merkinde meglmara gumanomugl ye ongo nigl kogl ana dungwa, “Yagl du-yene i gorambuka aglau i na mina paikrukwa. I ene konguno pangwa!”
Ana yomba prapra di ikine endingwa, “Ye gorambuka yumbunmo i yange no mina sinan ana nangro ye mina akiye panambuka!”
Ana Pailat eremogl Barabas kane pangwa imenda ende ye tongwa, ana ye dungo Yesus kumba wip singo ana tekoglo ende kimbirnem endi-prak mina sigoraglkwa pre tongwa.
Kimbirnem Yesus bakagl teingwa
Ana Pailat kimbirmo nem Yesus yendpi gavman yungu kande Pretorim we dimara suna eingwa, ana eresi yeingwa yomba ikra ye prapra wu suwara pi ye moglmara mogl winambo dingwa.
Kimbirnem Yesus gaglmo gugl ende ana gagl gogl mundu ta ende teingwa.

Te kewan kangigle orkwa indre king bitno gagl yeglmere beke indre ana ye bre mina pandigl tengwa. Te kumba ta indre ongo wokra pandigl teingwa. Ye prapra goglkono bondugl tendre ana bakaglte yegl dingwa, “Aya, Juda yomba kingno.”
Ye eursi Yesus tendre ana kumba ikra indre bre mina singwa.
Ana ye bakagl teingwa ikra dundungo ye gagl gogl ende teingwa ikra gugl ende ana ye yene gaglmo suna ende ikine ende teingwa. Ana ye endi-prak mina sina pre auro yend menda eingwa.
Yesus endi-prak mina singwa
Ye prapra ende menda eingo, yagl ta Sairini kamun nem, kangiye Saimon we dingwa. Ye tengigl yendre ana kimbirnem Yesus endimo-prak kake yenambedi ake nusingwa.
Ana ye ende wu dumo ta kangiye Golgata we dimara wingwa. (Golgata i mambunomo yegl, bitno yombuglo dumo.)
Kamunmo igle ye nigl geu orkwa indre wain bogl sikugl ende, Yesus ninambedi teingwa. Ba ye dra simbai pirtre okuwo nekrukwa.
Ye eremogl Yesus endi-prak mina si pandigltre ana ye gaglmo suna yumbusi inamunedi pre satu singwa.
Ana okuwo kimbirnem dumo igle amedi mogl, ye suglmo kanmeglkwa.
Ye bre wagle egli kra kot ereteingwa kamo ikra, yegl muno bogl endingo pangwa: I YESUS, JUDA YOMBA YE KINGNO.
Ana enge igle kunogl gogl nembrika yagl suwo ama akiye Yesus bogl endi-prak mina singwa. Ana ta ye ongo wokra pango te ta ongo kondakra pangwa.
Yomba wu ikine ikine eingwa i bitno piyasi Yesus bakagl tendre,
ana dingwa, “Ene God holi yungumo sigurndi atne ende pandigl ana ande enge suwota mina aglke kordagl kei ikine endinatngra. Ene God Wam motn kade, enene ere-indre endi-prak mina kondo ende atne wo!”
Dimere yegl keunde ama pris kande wagle ya te lo beke teingwa yomba ya te ende okuna eingwa yomba, Yesus bakagl tendre yegl dingwa,
“Ye yomba tau ere-yungwa ba ye yene ere-ikrambuka pangwa! Ye Israel yomba Kingno moglkrum kana! Ye kanwinge erimbi endi-prak mina kondo ana erme ende atne unan nono prapra ye pirngi dinamga.
Ye eremogl God pirngi dindre yegl dungwa, ‘Na God Wam mole,’ dungwa, ana erme God akeple dinan nono kanamna.”
Ana kunogl gogl nembrika yaglmo suwo-akiye Yesus bogl endi-prak mina singo pambrika. Yaglmo suwo i ama dimere kuno yegl di Yesus tembrika.
Yesus goglkwa
Ande kuiya 12 klok orko, makan koglkoglo mim waidi were kondungo pai endpi ande kuiya 3 klok orkwa.
Ana 3 klok mina, Yesus kai kaglkane binan bogl ere yegl dungwa, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” I mambuno yegl, “Na Godna, na Godna, sraglpre ene na kinde kondine?”
Yomba tau magl igle andigl meglkwa ye ka dungwa i pirtre ye dingwa, “Ye Elaija pre agle dungwa.”
Ana ye meglmara suwarata erme keunde mukundi pi ana giyagin indre, wain geu orkwa kurita simbai indre, buglo muglo mina pandigl ana Yesus bindi ninambedi pre tongwa.
Ba yomba tau yegl dingwa, “Kanwinge eriyo, Elaija wu ye ere-inambuka mo ere-ikrambuka, i nono sugl mogl kanamna.”
Ana Yesus aglke kordagl kaglkane pond indre, munduwo iyenda endungo ana spiritmo endongo ye goglkwa.
Ana engemo igle keunde God holi yungu yungugl gagl alap kugl beglkwa mitna imbo yei sunawom si-aragladi wu koglkoglo ongwa. Te makan pinga dungo ana kombuglo sibladi wu koglkoglo eingwa.
Kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara bukondi audungo ana God yombamo holi merkinde okuna geglkwa ye nangino bogl andigl ukor eingwa.
Ye kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara mina ende menda wingo ana okuwo Yesus anduglko, ye prapra ende God dumomo kande Jerusalem suna eingo ana yomba merkinde ye kanigwa.

Ana kimbirnem ende okuna ongwa yagle ta ya te kimbirnem tau ye bogl akiye Yesus suglmo meglkwa ana imem ungo, te taragl tau prapra orkwa i kandre ana ye kundugl gogl dingwa, “Kaima yene, ye God Wam moglkwa!”
Igle ambu merkinde Galili ye Yesus omara mokomugl pindre ana Yesus taragl doknan ye akepledi tenamnedi wingwa. Ana ye kurita eglke dagl mogl kanmeglkwa.
Ye meglmara suna i Makdala kamun mam Maria ya te Jems ya Josep mano Maria, te ta Sebedi wam suwo mano.
Yesus nangiye kombuglo dra mina yengwa
Kamun pokndungo, yagl ta di minge mere paitongwa Arimatia kamun nem, ye ungwa. Ye kangiye Josep, ana ye okuna ama Yesus disaipelma ta moglkwa.
Ye Pailat moglmara pindre ana Yesus nangiye pre krapoglko ana Pailat prawedi nangiye Josep teiyo dungwa.
Yeglpre Josep nangiye indre ana gagl alap kor ta were tongwa.
Ana Josep eremogl Yesus nangiye ipi ye yene kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara kor ta waugl yomara sunakra yongwa. Ana ye kombuglo kande ta egla pagl ipi maugl dra si pere dungwa.
Maria Makdala kamun mam ya te Maria ta ye igle tau eglke dagl amedi mogl kan kombuglo dra ende miurka.
Kimbirnem Yesus pandiglmara sugl meglkwa
Sabat pre akekun eraglkwa engemo
i magl ungo ana pris kande wagle ya Parisi wagle Pailat moglmara pindre,
ana yegl dingwa, “Yagl kande, no ka ta pir mounga. Ye kakimbi dungwa yagle, ye kor-moglkwa enge yegl dungwa, ‘Na ande enge suwota yenan aglke andigl ukor enaglka.’

Yeglpre ene dimin ye pandiglmara pra sugl wakai mogl-embi, ande enge suwota erano. Aglau eran yene disaipelma wagle wu ye nangiye kunogl indre ana yomba kakimbi ditenaglkwa. Ye andigl ukor omiwo dimbi ana okuwo kakimbi dinaglkwa i wu kande kaima pi ana komuno dungwa i engrambuka.”
Ana Pailat ye ditongwa, “Kimbirnem tau imbi, ye pindre ana kombuglo dra pandiglmara ene pirmere ere sugl wakai yene molondo.”
Ana ye pindre pandiglmara kombuglo dra mina bolamugl ye diu ta ere pandigl ana kimbirnem diendingo kombuglo dra sugl meglkwa.

footnotes.text: Pailat, Rom yagl ta moglkwa. Rom yomba diendingo ana ye Juda yomba mina gavana moglkwa. Juda yomba yene Yesus sigoglkraglkwa pangwa. Rom yomba keunde yomba suwara ta pra gorambe dinaglkwa pangwa. Yeglpre, Juda yomba eremogl Yesus auro ipi Pailat moglmara eingwa. Jon 18:31 mina kano.

Kimbirnem wagle, Yesus bakaglte tena pre ana king mereyegl ekin gagl bakagl tengwa. Enge i king wagle ekin yegl gagl gagl erikwa. Gagl gogl ende, king bitno gagl pandigl ana king botno mina amedi mogltre, ye buglo ta onguno mina ake meglkwa.
